outcome: Birth outcomes (healthy newborns, medical termination/abortion, neonatal death)
Fetal/child side effects (mental retardation, childhood cancer, malformation)
cohort: The study included 63 pregnant patients diagnosed with cancer who underwent (18F)-FDG PET/CT between 2015 and 2020.
finding: (18F)-FDG PET/CT has a major impact on the management of pregnancy-associated cancers, leading to stage modification and treatment changes, and appears feasible and safe during pregnancy with no reported fetal side effects within two years.
gest_age: Median 24.8 weeks of gestation at PET/CT, with exams performed across all trimesters.
